string-array.item: The player on a phone held sideways: the seek bar runs the whole width, on a row of its own.
Its top bar there is as slim as the title and fades into the video.
Android TV: Up from a page reaches the nearest button of the header, and the Favorites row of the Network page.
Android TV: the focus returns to the file you played, also far down a long list.
Android TV: Play all is offered only where there is something to play.
